Every app shares through Android TV's Watch Next list; your favourites also share through their own home-screen rows. Entries and artwork must be published by each app. Apps that keep progress private cannot be read by a launcher.

Only what you are watching shows: what you started, and the next episode of a series you are partway through. App suggestions are left out: YouTube's Recommended, Subscriptions and Trending rows, and "new season" or watchlist cards. YouTube shares your resume points only with Google TV's own home screen, and Netflix shares none, so neither app shows here.

CloudStream only shares portrait posters: the matching wide artwork is fetched from the same image sites. Hidden items are excluded from these counts.
TV listings access is needed to read Continue Watching.

Yahoo Finance has no such symbol. Find the share on finance.yahoo.com and enter its symbol as shown there, for example RELIANCE.NS.
Quotes from Yahoo Finance\'s unofficial endpoint may be delayed or unavailable. This is not investment advice. The list is manual and does not sync your Google Finance watchlist.
Live Google Home device status is not connected in this build. Direct integration needs the Google Home SDK, app registration, account consent, and testing on this TV. No device status is simulated.

No ads, analytics, account scraping or always-on bridge. Widgets refresh only while Home is visible.

Weather: unless you choose a city, the TV's approximate place is looked up from its internet address (ipwho.is) at most every 6 hours. The place's coordinates go to Open-Meteo (free, keyless) at most every 30 minutes.

Watchlist: your symbols go to Yahoo Finance at most every 5 minutes.

Up next: sports fixtures from Jolpica (F1) and TheSportsDB's free public key, at most every 6 hours. Only the team and league numbers are sent.

Continue Watching artwork: wide versions of CloudStream posters come from the same public image hosts (Metahub, TheTVDB) the app already uses.

Inputs and wallpapers stay on the TV. The wallpaper sync scripts remove location and camera data from photos before copying them. Photos are kept in telepath's own folder; on Android 11 and newer, other apps can't read it.

telepath is a GPLv3 fork of Plume Launcher. Free My TV inspired the widgets page.

Enter up to five Yahoo Finance symbols separated by commas, for example AAPL, ^GSPC, NIFTY, SENSEX or RELIANCE.NS. A share entered without its exchange, such as RELIANCE, is looked up and saved with it.\n\nThis is a manual list, not your Google Finance watchlist. Quotes may be delayed.
